job_location: Innsbruck or Vienna, Austria, or remote within the EU

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Sicherstellung der Datenqualität end-to-end – Tests, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung über den gesamten Stack
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize tested/documented data models, data quality end-to-end, and reliable ingestion, with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Bluecode is a FinTech/payments company and payments-data familiarity is named as a nice-to-have, but no explicit regulatory/audit/financial-reporting override language appears in responsibilities, keeping this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing dbt/BigQuery/Looker stack and 'Business Intelligence & Analytics Team' are already named as being maintained and extended, indicating a growing but already-established data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, Aufbau und Pflege unserer Transformationsschicht in dbt auf BigQuery – gut strukturierte, getestete und dokumentierte Datenmodelle
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise tools and methodology (dbt on BigQuery, LookML semantic layer, ELT via Fivetran/Dagster, tracking plans/event taxonomies) that show exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Gemeinsam mit Produkt- und Engineering-Teams Event-Tracking und Instrumentierung definieren und aufsetzen
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role splits fairly evenly between internal-data infrastructure (dbt/BigQuery modeling layer) and product analytics (event tracking, product/business metrics with Product and Engineering teams), giving mixed weight to both.
evidence.autonomy_level: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des semantischen/BI-Layers in Looker (LookML): verlässliche, unternehmensweit konsistente Metriken und Dashboards für Teams im ganzen Unternehmen
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns building a company-wide semantic layer and defining metrics (strategic) while also executing specific KPI monitoring and ad-hoc stakeholder requests (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role: AI-Tools einsetzen, um Analysen zu beschleunigen und Self-Service-Analytics zu ermöglichen – z.B. Conversational Analytics in Looker oder AI-gestützte Auswertungen
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to actively use AI tools to accelerate their own analysis work, the defining signal of ai_user, though there is also a secondary ai_enabler-adjacent bullet about building AI-powered internal tools/agents.
evidence.testing_framing: Sicherstellung der Datenqualität end-to-end – Tests, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung über den gesamten Stack
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality/testing is framed as an owned end-to-end responsibility with explicit ownership language ('Sicherstellung' = ensuring), not just a tool in a requirements list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Sicherstellung der Datenqualität end-to-end – Tests, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung über den gesamten Stack
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data quality and reliable ingestion are named as ongoing secondary concerns without regulatory or stakeholder-trust language dominating the JD, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des semantischen/BI-Layers in Looker (LookML)
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-build language (Aufbau/build) with maintain/extend language (Pflege, Weiterentwicklung, Mithilfe bei Pflege und Ausbau) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
evidence.language_gate: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (Arbeitssprache); Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil
evidence.work_arrangement: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten – von zu Hause und/oder in unseren modernen, zentralen Büros in Innsbruck und Wien
evidence.loss_aversion: Sicherstellung der Datenqualität end-to-end – Tests, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung über den gesamten Stack — a secondary operational-quality concern, not a dominant compliance risk register.
